summary.text: John Spiros is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 86 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Andy Wuethrich.
Ballotpedia lists him as vice president of Safety and Claims Management for Roehl Transport.

paragraphs.text: John Spiros served in the U.S. Air Force, according to Ballotpedia.
He is vice president of Safety and Claims Management for Roehl Transport and was a member of the Marshfield City Council from 2005 to 2013.
Spiros assumed office in the Assembly on January 7, 2013.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Review of Administrative Rules, Criminal Justice and Public Safety (chair), Science, Technology, and AI, State Affairs, Transportation (vice-chair), Veterans and Military Affairs, and the Joint Legislative Council.
